parallel.requirements: The parent recognized that bat 0.26.1 had to be reimplemented from observed CLI behavior and bundled docs, without source lookup or wrapping.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It chose a first recon phase using one AgentSwarm with six children, each assigned a behavior area and told not to write implementation code; the parent planned to design and bootstrap after that phase.
parallel.implementation: After the swarm returned, the parent wrote Cargo.toml, src/config.rs, and src/theme.rs only; no main executable implementation was completed.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact combined child specs and corpus fixtures with a partial Rust skeleton, but lacked a buildable executable pipeline.
parallel.verification: Children performed many behavioral probes, but the parent did not run an integrated build or evaluator-aligned test before cancellation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator failed at compilation, with all 986 tests not run, because the delivered project was not a complete compiling reimplementation.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same clean-room bat reimplementation constraints and explored CLI behavior and bundled documentation locally.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It maintained one local todo plan, captured observations in notes and assets, and had no child agents or inter-agent handoffs.
serial.implementation: It did extensive probing and static output capture, then announced it would start implementation and created src, but did not deliver substantive buildable code.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact contained notes, captured outputs, assets, and src/assets directories rather than a finished executable.
serial.verification: It verified observed behavior against the reference binary during probing, but no final clone build or integrated acceptance run occurred.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator also failed at compilation, with all 986 tests not run, because the serial project was still incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the benchmark required a clean-room behavioral reimplementation of bat from the executable and docs only.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received and followed the same clean-room reimplementation prompt.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the outcome; both understood the task but did not finish a compiling implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed the first phase into six child recon areas and explicitly prohibited implementation in those child scopes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor with a local todo plan for observation, implementation, testing, and finalization.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel moved parallel capacity into recon-only ownership while serial kept investigation and later implementation in a single control flow.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child interfaces were spec deliverables rather than implementation modules, so the parent had to convert large reports into code after the swarm returned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated observations directly in one note stream and did not need to receive or reconcile child handoffs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel run introduced a report-to-parent handoff boundary; the serial run had no inter-agent context boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel began actual Rust project files only after the swarm phase, writing Cargo.toml and two shared modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial delayed implementation even longer, eventually announcing implementation and creating src after extensive solo probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced a partial typed skeleton; serial produced captures and notes with no comparable Rust module content.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent waited for and received one aggregate AgentSwarm result from all six children before proceeding.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; protocol validation recorded no delegation or subagent activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result join point that preceded implementation; serial did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final artifacts mixed multiple child-produced specs and tests with the parent's partial Rust skeleton.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final artifacts were notes, captured outputs, assets, and source directories from one actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared workspace aggregation of recon products; serial had single-owner artifact provenance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children verified behavior probes and corpus captures, but the final submitted clone did not compile under the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified many reference behaviors locally, but its final submitted clone also did not compile.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run reached integrated acceptance; parallel's extra child verification was not converted into a buildable executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after spending the first major phase in the recon swarm and then starting skeleton implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out after a long single-actor investigation and late implementation start.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exceeded budget, but parallel's deadline pressure followed a completed recon-only child phase; serial's pressure followed local probing.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed at compilation, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The concrete process difference is that parallel used six children for a completed recon/spec phase before the parent began implementation, whereas serial conducted one continuous solo investigation and then started implementation. Both paths left no complete compiling executable.
parallel_contributors: Recon-only child phase delayed implementation until after the AgentSwarm result.
Final artifact included specs, corpus fixtures, Cargo.toml, and two partial modules rather than a complete executable.
serial_contributors: Serial had no child handoff and kept observations in one local trajectory.
Serial also delayed implementation until too late and submitted captured assets without a complete source implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel wrote a partial Rust skeleton while serial primarily wrote notes and assets.
Both attempts faced a very large clean-room bat reimplementation and timed out before a compiling deliverable.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern describes realized adverse parallel process only

candidates.reason: The parent explicitly planned to bootstrap and implement after recon, so implementation was deferred rather than completely ownerless.
No separate child implementation components were completed that needed cross-agent integration ownership.
There was no complete promotable component set awaiting only final assembly; implementation itself remained partial.
The parent owned the overall transition from recon to skeleton to later implementation, even though it ran out of time.
The gate was not one mandatory harness or oracle preflight; it was a broad multi-child investigation phase.

The child agents overlapped only as investigators, all returned specs or fixtures, and implementation was deferred to the parent until after that phase, leaving only a partial skeleton before cancellation.
candidates.realized_consequence: Implementation began only after the recon swarm returned, leaving a partial Rust skeleton and no compiling executable by cancellation.
candidates.near_match_reason: The same evidence reflects a serial recon-first phase, not a distinct excessive breadth or retry episode beyond the retained pseudo-concurrency chain.

candidates.reason: The implementation path started late, but the direct boundary was the recon-only first phase already retained as Serial Investigation.
Six children consumed budget, but they were a single planned recon phase; no separate fan-out or retry exhaustion episode is evidenced.
No individual child had an overbroad implementation assignment that failed to checkpoint; all child scopes were recon/spec scopes.
The children were given the clean-room rules and their recon deliverables; the adverse issue was that implementation was intentionally excluded, not omitted from an implementation brief.
The delegated work produced specs rather than separately implemented components with incompatible interfaces.
No known child finding is shown to disappear during transfer and then cause repeated work.
The swarm result and spec files were large, but the parent did inspect them; the realized consequence is better explained by the recon-first phase.
No child result describes a superseded workspace or requirement state that the parent then used incorrectly.
No incompatible child reports or contracts remained unadjudicated at an integration decision point.
The parent did not present the whole task as complete; the run was cancelled while implementation remained partial.
The parallel trajectory shows no replacement or retry that repeated prior work without inherited checkpoint state.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: The parent did not explicitly stop a needed active child before its result finalized; the children returned through the swarm.
There was no complete directly promotable candidate or mutually compatible component set waiting for final placement.
No child implementation was merged after an integrated verification pass; no final integrated verification occurred.
No delegated implementation was completed or retrievable; children delivered recon specs rather than code to join.
No verifier child produced a trapped concrete finding below the parent before closure.
The child agents completed their recon scopes; there was no required child failure or cancellation requiring takeover.
The parent received the AgentSwarm result and proceeded to inspect specs and design; the result was not simply ignored.
The final timeout occurred after the swarm result while the parent was writing skeleton files, not while blindly waiting on available child progress.
Child outputs covered different spec areas and did not produce competing implementations of the same behavior.
No two live agents are shown editing the same source or configuration file and reconciling each other's change.
No agent replaced or rewrote non-entry source owned or produced by another agent.
No required executable or entry-point deliverable was replaced while another agent owned or used it.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple current outputs or invalidated final-tree provenance.
Although children wrote into a shared workspace, no concrete unstable-state or provenance problem beyond benign spec aggregation is proven.
Several children observed stale TodoList state from siblings, but they corrected or ignored it and no final artifact or verification input was contaminated.

retained_patterns.reason: Parallel used six children for a recon/spec-only phase, then the parent started implementation after receiving the aggregate result, which left no complete buildable executable by cancellation.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Implementation began only after the recon swarm returned, leaving a partial Rust skeleton and no compiling executable by cancellation.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The same timeout chain is better described by productive implementation being deferred behind a recon-first phase, not by a distinct excessive fan-out episode.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: No Implementation Owner, Critical-Path Starvation, Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Bulk Handoff Overload, and Blind Timeout Wait were considered but suppressed as the same recon-first timeout chain or unsupported by distinct consequences.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; only Serial Investigation cleared the retention gate with direct parallel anchors and a concrete consequence.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No downstream timeout, load, handoff, or shared-state label was added for the same episode because it would reuse the same evidence and consequence.
